text: その　そうこには　なにが　はいって　いるかって？

structure.jp: なにが　はいって　いるかって？

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which repeats what someone said. かって？ at the end repeats the other person's question back to them. いるかって = 'what's in it, you ask?'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here shows a lasting state: something went in and is still there. はいって　いる = 'is inside'.
